verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents several natural-language ways to drive the product. One sentence sets up an agent's name, role, skills and behaviors automatically. A single composer opens a Topic, creates a Task or starts a page. Onboarding turns what you tell it about your work into starter Tasks, and auto team formation plus a managing agent that hires, schedules and reports let you direct work conversationally. Missing for 10: no evidence that settings, navigation or the wider UI can be controlled through natural language (the Command Menu is not shown to accept natural language), no detailed docs on the natural-language command scope, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
